Mira selectively adapted method ideas for statistical evidence contracts,
figure-source preflight, reference authenticity, material anchors, and
claim-to-evidence chains. The active Mira skill does not redistribute the
upstream skill tree or its 164 training cases.

The Mira implementations are modified, contest-specific native components.
They add fail-closed contest-final semantics, Chinese mathematical-modeling
paper contracts, result-ledger binding, and Python/MATLAB provenance. Nature
journal and patent templates, R workflows, draw.io, Zotero/CNKI/MCP service
dependencies, publisher machinery, and AI-generated quantitative evidence are
explicitly excluded.
